title: Commercial Fusion Energy 2026: From Experimental Physics to Neutron-Qualified Power Plant Architecture
subtitle: Assembly is accelerating while net gain, neutron-resistant walls and a closed tritium cycle remain unproven — the architecture must close those three loops before mid-2030s deployment [S2][S4]

current_gaps.title: No Net Energy Gain
current_gaps.spec: No net-energy-gain device; gain factor above one only at NIF [S2][S6]

current_gaps.title: Unqualified First-Wall Materials
current_gaps.spec: Neutron-resistant structural materials and plasma-facing components remain unqualified for continuous bombardment [S2][S6]

current_gaps.title: Open Tritium Fuel Cycle
current_gaps.spec: No closed tritium cycle: breeding blankets unproven, 12.3-year decay drains inventory [S2][S6]

current_gaps.title: Appropriation Below Authorisation
current_gaps.spec: FY2027 FES authorised at $1.1B but only $790M appropriated — unresolved [S2]

current_gaps.title: No Electricity-Producing Device
current_gaps.spec: ITER is exploratory science only, not designed to produce electricity — unresolved against mid-2030s target [S1][S2]

evolution_matrix.key_upgrade: Replaces experimental short-pulse shots with operation at or near the ignition point of burning plasma [S1]
Replaces unqualified plasma-facing components with milestone-gated neutron-resistant structural materials [S2]
Replaces scarce purchased tritium, which decays with a half-life of about 12.3 years, with lithium breeding blankets [S6]
Replaces lessons-learned-per-module assembly with an accelerated sequence held to millimetre-level tolerances [S4]
Replaces year-by-year FES appropriations with the DOE roadmap's short, medium and long-term milestones [S2]

core_pillars.title: Burning-Plasma Core
core_pillars.concise_spec: Ignition-point burning plasma; sector 3 carries 120 magnetic-field sensors [S1][S3]

core_pillars.title: Tritium Fuel Cycle
core_pillars.concise_spec: Lithium breeding blankets close loop around 12.3-year tritium half-life [S6][S2]

core_pillars.title: Neutron-Survivable Materials
core_pillars.concise_spec: Neutron-resistant structural and plasma-facing components qualified against constant neutron flux [S2]

core_pillars.title: Assembly & Alignment
core_pillars.concise_spec: Millimetre-level alignment: 440-tonne sectors, two 310-tonne toroidal field coils [S4]

core_pillars.title: Programme Delivery
core_pillars.concise_spec: DOE roadmap three goals; $4.48 billion raised to July 2026 [S2]

expansion_stages.label: Sector Bench
expansion_stages.detail: Single sector module subassembly; sector 3 carries 120 sensors [S3]

expansion_stages.label: Tokamak Pit
expansion_stages.detail: Six sector modules installed; two-thirds of torus core in place [S4]

expansion_stages.label: Full Torus
expansion_stages.detail: Final module targeted mid-2027; 93-bellow welding runs five years [S4][S3]

expansion_stages.label: Fleet / Grid
expansion_stages.detail: 28 U.S. fusion companies cite grid connection in the 2030s [S2]

validation_benches.title: Net Gain Proof
validation_benches.test_criteria: Gain factor above one demonstrated; NIF remains the sole laboratory today [S6]

validation_benches.title: Alignment Tolerance
validation_benches.test_criteria: Sector module lands to millimetre-level tolerance within a 30-hour lift [S4]

validation_benches.title: Tritium Closure
validation_benches.test_criteria: Bred supply offsets 12.3-year half-life decay; inventory stays closed [S6][S2]

validation_benches.title: Funding Reconciliation
validation_benches.test_criteria: FY2027 FES appropriation reaches the $1.1 billion authorised ceiling, not $790 million [S2]
